import Mathlib

namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem final_dev_0203 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card B - card (A ∩ B) := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem final_dev_0203 {α : Type _} (A B : Set α) : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
  classical
  have h1 : card (A ∪ B) = card A + card (B \ A) := by
    rw [Set.union_eq_add_diff_inter]
  have h2 : card (B \ A) = card B - card (A ∩ B) := by
    rw [Set.diff_eq_sub, Set.inter_eq_self_of_subset, Set.subset_def, Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_inter, Set.mem_singleton]
    exact fun x => by
      cases x
      exact Set.mem_singleton_self x
  rw [h1, h2]
end Nl2LeanCandidate

example : @Nl2LeanExpected.final_dev_0203 = @Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0203 := by
  exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
#print axioms Nl2LeanCandidate.final_dev_0203
